variants.title: A · Continuity
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, high-resolution desktop design concept sheet for Engineering Board. Landscape 4:3 aspect ratio approximately 2048x1536. This is a raster VISUAL OPTION, not a working app. Do not photograph a monitor; show crisp flat interface design edge to edge. Two clearly distinct screen regions on the same sheet: upper 40% a public landing-page introduction, lower 60% a read-only investigation screen. A slim sheet label identifies the option. Both regions share one visual system. Typography must be large enough to read; omit minor details instead of tiny unreadable copy. Generous margins, sharp text, professional spacing.

EXACT SHARED COPY / CONTENT:
Product name "Engineering Board". Navigation "Example", "Install", "Docs".
Headline "Connect findings. Inspect the evidence."
Subtitle "Repository memory for engineering agents."
Actions "Start with Codex" and "Explore example".
Small first-use line: "Ask Codex to initialize Engineering Board in this repository."
Expected result: "A repository-owned Markdown board."
The lower screen must visibly say "Synthetic example" and "Read-only".
Three evidence items, each with ID and title: B001 "Worker skips a review-ready entry"; B002 "Board shows the wrong lane"; B003 "Ready-work list omits the entry".
Hypothesis H001 headline "Lifecycle rules differ across adapters."
Prominent TEXT state label "Proposed hypothesis".
Supporting section "Evidence": "Three findings share a lifecycle-state pattern."
Supporting section "Alternative": "Independent filtering errors."
Supporting section "Falsifier": "All adapters use the same rule."
Outcome text "No outcome recorded."
Controls "Open source record" and "Back to findings".
Show three findings connected to a PROPOSED interpretation; never show confirmed cause, causal probability, performance statistics or invented metrics.
No account avatar, no login, no billing, no team invitations, no chat composer, no editable controls. No huge decorative network, gradients, glow, photography, stock art or extra products' logos. Avoid redundant dashboards, generic metric cards, microscopically dense UI, device frames or perspective. Treat icons as minimal.

DIRECTION A — CONTINUITY. Evolution of existing Engineering Board identity. Sheet label "A / Continuity". Dominant warm paper canvas #FAF9F5, ink #17191E text, white inner panels and amber #9A5B00 for primary actions and a small familiar mark of two card columns with one card bridging them. Mark is modest and functional. Use system grotesque sans type, heavy 58px left-aligned headline, 18px supporting copy, 16px interface body. 10px corner radius on evidence cards, thin neutral borders, no visible shadows. Borrow Factory's split hero and precise ruled hierarchy only; no Factory branding. Upper screen: headline and actions on LEFT, compact three-findings-to-hypothesis relationship preview on RIGHT, explanatory rather than decorative. Lower screen: broad warm-white record area with 3 clearly legible evidence cards on the left and the proposed hypothesis with evidence, alternative, falsifier in a wider right pane. Include source/back actions. Modest amber rule emphasizes the selected item, NEVER means confirmed. Communicate approachable engineering precision and recognition. Main CTA amber with light text; underline source links. The composition should look confident, warm-neutral and familiar, NOT cream editorial lifestyle or luxury serif.

DIRECTION B — SOURCEBOOK. Sheet label "B / Sourcebook".
